plan.scope: 1 KiB HTTP/1 keepalive, 64 connections, two workers; diagnostic probes separate from formal comparison

candidate.hypothesis: Reduce I/O readiness delivery delay when connection and upstream driver tasks keep the ready queue busy
candidate.retain_condition: Check product P99 and throughput with matched controls; revert if no consistent tail benefit or material throughput regression; do not turn failed AA into a gain claim
candidate.scheduler_probe: 64 self-waking tasks at50us per poll;61 interval125polls/6281us vs16 interval80polls/4029.5us;10 alternating trials each; mechanism only, not product performance

formal_design.pilot: baseline Hyper vs event16 Hyper, two repeats each,12s+3s warmup;screen only, never combined with formal data
formal_design.before_after: baseline Hyper vs retained candidate Hyper,three rounds,two repeats per round,30s+5s warmup
formal_design.engine_comparison: Pingora vs retained candidate Hyper,same three-round30s+5s design
formal_design.qualification: rps max AA and CV<=10%,P99<=20%,zero errors; failed controls retained
formal_design.duration_reason: Changed before any candidate performance samples: longer windows for small sub-millisecond P99 differences; workload and gates unchanged.

raw_latency_diagnostic.purpose: Check whether raw latency agrees with corrected P99; original formal metric and gates unchanged
raw_latency_diagnostic.design: baselineHyper/event16Hyper two samples each,15s+5s warmup,after all formal windows
raw_latency_diagnostic.method: Save corrected histogram using wrk Lua done() only after timed requests; invert known4.1.0 stats_correct and require exact re-correction and raw sample count equal summary.requests
raw_latency_diagnostic.qualification: diagnostic only,two samples do not meet formal three-pair gate

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'scripts'))
import benchmark_compare as b

probe = '--probe' in sys.argv
if probe:
    sys.argv.remove('--probe')
original_start = b.start
original_measure = b.measure


def start(command, log_path, transport=None):
    if probe and transport == 'hyper':
        command = [*command, '--hyper-wakeup-probe']
    return original_start(command, log_path, transport)


def measure(args, url, script, concurrency, seconds, server, origin, metrics_port=None):
    before = b.request(metrics_port, '/metrics')[2].decode() if metrics_port else None
    run = original_measure(args, url, script, concurrency, seconds, server, origin, metrics_port)
    if metrics_port:
        run['diagnostic_metrics_before'] = before
        run['diagnostic_metrics_after'] = b.request(metrics_port, '/metrics')[2].decode()
    return run


b.start = start
b.measure = measure
b.main()

"""Capture wrk's completed histogram and invert its 4.1/4.2 correction after the run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys


def undo(histogram, interval):
    counts = dict(histogram)
    original = {}
    for value in sorted(counts, reverse=True):
        count = counts[value]
        assert count >= 0, (value, count)
        if count:
            original[value] = count
        if value >= interval * 2:
            previous = value - interval
            while count and previous > interval:
                assert previous in counts
                counts[previous] -= count
                previous -= interval
    return original


def percentile(histogram, percent):
    rank = math.floor(percent / 100 * sum(histogram.values()) + 1)
    total = 0
    for value, count in sorted(histogram.items()):
        total += count
        if total >= rank:
            return value / 1000


if '--self-test' in sys.argv:
    # Fixed external stats_correct contract: n=20 adds nothing at interval=10;
    # n=35 contributes to25 and15, while original25 also contributes to15.
    corrected = {5: 40, 10: 20, 15: 8, 20: 10, 25: 8, 35: 3}
    assert undo(corrected, 10) == {5: 40, 10: 20, 20: 10, 25: 5, 35: 3}
    print('wrk correction inversion boundary check passed')
    raise SystemExit

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'scripts'))
import benchmark_compare as b

original_fixtures, original_measure = b.fixtures, b.measure
histogram_file = None


def fixtures(args, directory, ports):
    global histogram_file
    version = b.command_output([args.wrk, '--version'], accepted=(0, 1))
    assert version.startswith('wrk ') and any(tag in version for tag in ['4.1.0', '4.2.0']), version
    original_fixtures(args, directory, ports)
    histogram_file = directory / 'latency-last.json'
    lua = '''
local original_done = done
function done(summary, latency, requests)
  original_done(summary, latency, requests)
  local f = assert(io.open(HISTOGRAM_PATH, "w"))
  f:write(string.format('{"duration_us":%d,"requests":%d,"histogram":[', summary.duration, summary.requests))
  for i = 1, #latency do
    local value, count = latency(i)
    if i > 1 then f:write(',') end
    f:write(string.format('[%d,%d]', value, count))
  end
  f:write(']}')
  f:close()
end
'''.replace('HISTOGRAM_PATH', json.dumps(str(histogram_file)))
    for case in args.cases:
        path = directory / f'wrk-{case}.lua'
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + lua)


def measure(args, url, script, concurrency, seconds, server, origin, metrics_port=None):
    run = original_measure(args, url, script, concurrency, seconds, server, origin, metrics_port)
    captured = json.loads(histogram_file.read_text())
    assert captured['requests'] == run['requests']
    corrected = dict(captured['histogram'])
    interval = captured['duration_us'] // (captured['requests'] // concurrency)
    original = undo(corrected, interval)
    assert sum(original.values()) == captured['requests']
    recorrected = original.copy()
    for value, count in sorted(original.items()):
        previous = value - interval
        while value >= interval * 2 and previous > interval:
            recorrected[previous] = recorrected.get(previous, 0) + count
            previous -= interval
    assert recorrected == corrected
    assert abs(percentile(corrected, 99) - run['p99_ms']) < 0.000001
    run['histograms'] = {'kind': 'diagnostic, no per-request callback; histogram processing after timed run',
        'expected_interval_us': interval, 'raw_samples': sum(original.values()),
        'corrected_samples': sum(corrected.values()),
        'raw_p50_ms': percentile(original, 50), 'raw_p95_ms': percentile(original, 95),
        'raw_p99_ms': percentile(original, 99), 'raw_us_counts': sorted(original.items()),
        'corrected_us_counts': sorted(corrected.items())}
    return run


b.fixtures, b.measure = fixtures, measure
b.main()
